title: Fiber Broadband Outage and Red LOS (Loss of Signal) Light on GPON Router
content: A blinking or steady red LOS (Loss of Signal) light on your GPON optical fiber router indicates that no optical light signal is reaching the device. Causes include an outdoor fiber cable cut due to construction, excessive bend in the yellow fiber patch cord, or a detached green SC/APC connector. Troubleshooting: Gently check that the yellow fiber cable has no sharp kinks or pinches, ensure the green connector is firmly clicked into the router PON port, and power-cycle the router for 30 seconds. If the red LOS remains lit, an automated fiber repair technician ticket is dispatched with an 8-hour SLA.

title: Wi-Fi Speed Optimization and Dual-Band (2.4 GHz vs 5 GHz) Configuration
content: Modern fiber routers broadcast dual Wi-Fi bands: The 2.4 GHz band provides broad coverage across multiple rooms and penetrates solid walls effectively, but has a theoretical throughput ceiling of 50 to 70 Mbps. The 5 GHz band delivers ultra-high gigabit speeds up to 800+ Mbps with near-zero latency, ideal for 4K streaming and gaming, but has a shorter unobstructed range (10-15 meters). Ensure high-demand devices connect to the '5G' SSID and position the router in a central, elevated location away from microwave ovens.

title: Broadband Fair Usage Policy (FUP) Data Limits and Speed Throttling
content: Unlimited fiber broadband plans provide a massive monthly data quota of 3,300 GB (3.3 Terabytes) at symmetrical plan speed (e.g. 100 Mbps, 300 Mbps, or 1 Gbps). If the cumulative consumption reaches the 3,300 GB threshold within a single billing cycle, speeds are throttled to 1 Mbps post-FUP under regulatory commercial guidelines. High-speed quota resets automatically on the 1st day of the subsequent billing cycle, or top-up data boosters can be purchased instantly via the self-care app.

title: Static Public IP Address Allocation for CCTV, VPN, and Web Servers
content: Subscribers requiring a persistent static IP for remote CCTV camera monitoring, private cloud hosting, port forwarding, or enterprise corporate VPN authentication can subscribe to a Static IPv4 address for ₹250 per month plus GST. Static IPs are configured remotely on the subscriber ONT profile within 4 hours without requiring any on-site technician visit or hardware change.

title: Shifting and Relocating Broadband Connection to a New Address
content: When moving residence or office, customers can submit a connection shifting request inside the self-care mobile app 48 hours in advance. Feasibility at the target location is verified automatically via fiber GIS mapping. The customer brings their existing ONT router and power adapter to the new premises; a certified field technician completes fiber splicing, outdoor drop-cable pulling, and signal activation with zero downtime.

title: Broadband Billing Cycle, Payment Due Date, and Suspension Grace Period
content: Broadband invoices are generated on the 1st of each month with a payment due date of the 15th. A 3-day grace period is provided beyond the due date. If payment is not completed by the 18th, outgoing internet access is temporarily redirected to a payment reminder gateway. Services restore within 5 minutes of bill payment. Setting up AutoPay via UPI or Credit Card provides an exclusive 5% billing rebate.

title: Landline VoIP Voice Calling Configuration on Optical Fiber ONT Router
content: All unlimited fiber broadband plans include complimentary unlimited local and STD voice calling to any network in India through VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol). To use landline calling, plug any standard RJ11 analog telephone instrument into the 'Phone' or 'TEL 1' port on the rear of the fiber router. When the VoIP status LED on the router turns solid green, dial tone is active with crystal-clear HD audio.

title: ONT Router UPS Battery Backup and Inverter Compatibility
content: During power outages, standard household inverters may cause brief voltage fluctuations that restart fiber routers. Customers can install a dedicated mini DC-UPS (12V 2A output) directly between the power adapter and router. A mini-UPS provides 4 to 6 hours of continuous, uninterrupted internet and voice calling during power cuts, preventing work-from-home disruption.

title: Parental Control, Child Safety, and Safe Search DNS Filtering
content: Subscribers can enforce family-safe browsing and restrict adult or malicious domains by configuring SafeSearch DNS or Parental Controls inside the router gateway settings at 192.168.1.1. Parents can schedule Wi-Fi downtime for specific children's devices during study hours or bedtime and block inappropriate gaming and social media servers.

title: Wi-Fi Password Modification and Guest Network Isolation Protocol
content: To change your Wi-Fi name (SSID) or WPA2/WPA3 password: Log in to the self-care mobile app or open a web browser to http://192.168.1.1 using admin credentials. Under Wireless Settings, update the security key and click Save. For visiting guests, enable the 'Guest Network' feature; this provides internet connectivity while isolating guests from accessing your private networked laptops, NAS drives, or printers.

title: Low Latency Gaming Optimization, MTU Size, and Packet Loss Fixes
content: Online gamers experiencing jitter, high ping latency, or packet loss should connect their gaming console or PC via a shielded Cat6 Ethernet cable rather than Wi-Fi. Ensure MTU is set to 1492 for PPPoE fiber connections. Setting primary DNS to 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) or 8.8.8.8 (Google) reduces DNS lookup lag and routing hops to international gaming servers.

title: Temporary Broadband Safe Custody Plan for Out-of-Station Travelers
content: Subscribers traveling out of town or vacationing for up to 3 months can request temporary 'Safe Custody' suspension. Under Safe Custody, regular plan billing is paused, and a nominal retention fee of ₹150 per month applies to hold the optical port and equipment. Internet access is reactivated instantly on the chosen return date without reconnection charges.

title: Digital eSIM Activation, Profile Download, and QR Code Scanning
content: To convert a physical SIM to an eSIM: Send an SMS 'eSIM <registered_email_id>' to 199 from your smartphone. You will receive an SMS requesting confirmation; reply '1' within 60 minutes. An encrypted eSIM QR code will be emailed to your inbox. On your smartphone, navigate to Settings -> Cellular / Mobile Data -> Add eSIM, scan the QR code, and download the carrier profile. The eSIM activates within 2 hours.

title: Physical SIM Replacement Procedure for Damaged or Lost SIMs
content: If a physical SIM card is damaged, demagnetized, or lost with a phone, visit any company-owned retail store with your original Aadhaar card for biometric e-KYC. A duplicate replacement SIM is handed over immediately for ₹50. The replacement SIM activates within 4 hours. Under security regulations, outgoing SMS services are blocked for 24 hours post-activation to safeguard against banking OTP hijacking.

title: International Roaming Packs, Free Incoming, and In-Flight Connectivity
content: International Roaming packs are available across 1-day, 10-day, and 30-day options covering over 120 destinations (USA, UK, UAE, Europe, Singapore, Thailand). Packs include high-speed data allowances, free incoming voice calls, and outgoing minutes to India. Roaming packs can be scheduled in advance via the app and activate automatically upon landing at the foreign airport.
